solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Teacher to exchange mains device

parts.note: a schoolmaster is a teacher
to switch is to swap or exchange

explanation.surface: A teacher swaps over some piece of electrical equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A master switch controls the supply from the mains to a whole system.

clue.text: By and large a couple of lines repeated about having arrived

indicators.note: about says the doubled piece goes around the word for having arrived
repeated says the short piece made of a plus two lines is written twice over

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for line, so two lines give LL
someone who has arrived is in

explanation.surface: Generally, a pair of lines is said twice around someone's arrival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repeated' doubles the A plus two lines, and 'about' wraps that pair round the word for arrived, so it sits between the two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: All in all is an idiom meaning on the whole, the same as by and large.

clue.text: Book coming my way

parts.note: coming towards somewhere is coming to it
coming my way means coming towards me

explanation.surface: A book is heading in my direction.
explanation.definitionFit: A tome is a large, heavy book.

clue.text: Engineers' fast time on the continental ship becomes inexorable

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army's engineering corps
Lent is the Christian season of fasting
le is French for the
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: Army engineers' period of fasting aboard a French ship turns unyielding.
explanation.definitionFit: Relentless and inexorable are synonyms: both describe something that will not stop or give way.

clue.text: Wife and I would obtain gizmo

parts.note: I would contracts to I'd
to get is to obtain

explanation.surface: A married couple plan to acquire a gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: A widget is a small gadget, a synonym of gizmo.

clue.text: Attempt to embody outstanding Queen in decorative pattern

indicators.note: to embody is to contain, so the attempt holds the following pieces inside it

parts.note: a try is an attempt
ace means excellent or outstanding
R stands for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: An effort to portray a great queen within an ornamental design.
explanation.definitionFit: Tracery is ornamental stonework or a lacy decorative pattern, as in Gothic windows.

clue.text: Frank's stirring rather hot tea

definitions.note: Frank's is read as frank is, the adjective meaning candid, with the 's as a link

indicators.note: stirring mixes up the letters of the tea and the words before it

explanation.surface: Frank is stirring a cuppa that is rather too hot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' looks like a man's name but is the adjective meaning candid.
explanation.definitionFit: A heart-to-heart talk is an open, candid one, so the phrase can describe something frank.

clue.text: Despite being oversensitive reach journey's end

parts.note: to touch something is to reach it

indicators.note: end picks out the final letter of journey

explanation.surface: Though easily upset, a traveller reaches the end of a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Touchy is a synonym of oversensitive: quick to take offence.

clue.text: Tax one leaving coral island

indicators.note: leaving says the letter for one departs from the island word

parts.note: an atoll is a ring-shaped coral island
a means one

explanation.surface: Someone pays a levy before departing a tropical reef island.
explanation.definitionFit: A toll is a charge or tax, as on a road or bridge.

clue.text: Mother takes in older sort of play

indicators.note: takes in means the mother word contains the following piece

parts.note: mama is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: sort of signals that older is rearranged into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Mother brings in an older kind of play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of play' wants to be the definition, but 'sort of' is the anagram signal and only 'play' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A melodrama is a sensational kind of play with exaggerated characters.

clue.text: Having 41 winks?

parts.note: forty winks is a short nap, so taking one more than forty means sleeping too long

explanation.surface: Someone takes one wink more than a short nap.
explanation.walkthrough: The '41' points back to clue numbers but is just the number one more than forty.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking more than the proverbial forty winks means staying asleep past the intended time.

clue.text: Empty vat can be overturned

indicators.note: be overturned signals that the letters of vat and can are tipped into a new order

explanation.surface: An empty vat may be tipped over.
explanation.definitionFit: Vacant is a synonym of empty: unoccupied or containing nothing.

clue.text: Return from the market

parts.note: reads as coming back from the shops, but means the yield earned on money invested in the stock market

explanation.surface: Someone comes back from the shops.
explanation.definitionFit: Interest is the income or yield earned on money that has been invested.

clue.text: Something to read from time to time

definitions.meaning: a magazine or journal is something to read
as an adjective it means occurring at intervals

explanation.definitionFit: A periodical is a regularly published magazine, and the adjective means occurring now and then.

clue.text: Secretion regenerated jolly early!

indicators.note: regenerated means made again, so the letters of jolly early are reformed in a new order

explanation.surface: A bodily fluid is renewed remarkably soon.
explanation.definitionFit: Royal jelly is the substance secreted by worker bees to feed larvae and queens.

clue.text: Novice from Austrian province not an inexperienced driver

indicators.note: not says the learner's letter is left out of the province name

parts.note: Tyrol is a province in western Austria
L is the learner plate shown by a learner driver in Britain

explanation.surface: A beginner from an Alpine region who is not a learner motorist.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyro is a beginner or novice.

clue.text: Finish in haste and stop work

definitions.meaning: to dash off or complete something quickly
to clock off at the end of the working day

explanation.definitionFit: To knock off is both to produce something quickly and to finish work for the day.

clue.text: Record circular design

parts.note: a log is a written record
O is a circular letter

explanation.surface: Someone notes down a round pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: A logo is an emblem or design identifying a company.

clue.text: Demon girl — men excited!

indicators.note: excited means stirred up, so the letters of girl and men are jumbled

explanation.surface: A wicked young woman sends the men wild.
explanation.definitionFit: A gremlin is an imaginary mischievous sprite blamed for mechanical faults, a kind of demon.

clue.text: In seconds a dreadful lack of harmony

indicators.note: dreadful signals that the preceding words are badly mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Within moments, a terrible clash of sound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In seconds' looks like a phrase of time, but those words plus 'a' are the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissonance is discord: a lack of harmony in music or relations.

clue.text: Roam about in Holland as usual

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters within the country code

parts.note: NL is the international code for the Netherlands

indicators.note: about signals the letters of roam are moved around

explanation.surface: Wander around the Netherlands as you always do.
explanation.definitionFit: Normal and usual are synonyms: what is typical or customary.

clue.text: Old hand boards with little resistance

parts.note: the boards is a theatrical term for the stage
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A veteran climbs aboard with hardly any opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boards' looks like a verb (gets on) but is the noun for the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: An old stager is an experienced person, an old hand.

clue.text: Still said to be bound together at end of day

parts.note: even, as in even more, means still

indicators.note: said shows that the following words are spoken and a word of the same sound is written

parts.note: tied means bound together

explanation.surface: People are still reported to be joined together at nightfall.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventide is an old poetic word for evening, the end of the day.

clue.text: Recorder making twenty?

definitions.meaning: one who keeps a record, as of points in a game
a score is twenty, so something that makes a score of things

explanation.definitionFit: A scorer records points, and whimsically something making a score is one that makes twenty.

clue.text: Bellyful causes greedy person to lose weight

indicators.note: to lose means the unit of weight is dropped from the greedy person

parts.note: a glutton eats too much
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A fullness drives an overeater to slim down.
explanation.definitionFit: A glut is an excess, as of food: a bellyful.

clue.text: Irrational when unwell, go back in charge with the Parisian female returning

parts.note: ill means unwell

indicators.note: back says the word go is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: returning says the French feminine article is turned around

parts.note: la is the French feminine form of the

explanation.surface: It makes no sense, when sick, to resume command with the French woman coming back.
explanation.definitionFit: Illogical means lacking sound reasoning, a synonym of irrational.

clue.text: Ring little Katharine who is satisfactory

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
Kay is a short form of Katharine

explanation.surface: Phone young Kate, who is fine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ring' looks like a phone call but is the round letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: Okay is an informal word for acceptable or satisfactory.

clue.text: Military advisers in fees rant — flag desecrated

indicators.note: desecrated means violated, so the letters of the fees rant and flag are mangled

explanation.surface: Army advisers protest about costs while a banner is defiled.
explanation.definitionFit: The general staff are the officers who advise a commander on military planning.
